title: Pao Verde Crunch
description: A delightful combination of crunchy and savory flavors, all wrapped up in a delicious verde sauce.
instructions: Cut the pao bread into cubes.
Toss the bread cubes with umami paste until well coated.
Spread the crunchy vegetable slaw on a baking sheet.
Bake the slaw for 5-7 minutes or until crispy.
In a separate pan, toast the bread cubes for 2-3 minutes or until golden brown.
In a bowl, mix together the verde sauce and lime juice.
To assemble, place a toasted bread cube on a plate, top with crunchy slaw, and drizzle with verde sauce.
Repeat the layers two more times, finishing with a drizzle of verde sauce on top.
